{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Small businesses employ half of all working Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Over the last two decades, small businesses have created two out of three net new jobs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe that small businesses are the engine of job growth in America.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Obama signed 18 small-business tax cuts to encourage businesses to hire more workers and make job-creating investments in machinery and equipment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Obama proposed significant additional small business tax relief.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Obama encouraged investment and supported start-ups by allowing businesses to write off the full cost of new equipment and machinery they bought in 2011.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President's Small Business Jobs Act accelerated $55 billion in tax relief through 2011.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats made it easier for small businesses to access the loans they needed to grow and hire.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President signed into law changes to help entrepreneurs raise capital while maintaining key investor protections.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Small businesses are now once again creating jobs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats have helped small businesses provide health insurance to their workers with a tax credit to help pay for the cost of coverage.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In 2014, the tax credit will grow and small businesses will be able to pool their purchasing power together to get affordable coverage.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
